     prompt, and the rendered-reference judge brief. It maps surfaceColor to
     the dominant page surface, heroColor to the hero surface, limited brand
     bands, action accents, and states that the client brief wins over a
     conflicting reference surface direction. This targets the measured
     paletteAdherence 56/80 failure where candidate-a flooded the page with
     the ink-blue brand surface against a warm-stone brief.
  3. Repair findings now include each missed rendered-fidelity dimension and
     its threshold (for example paletteAdherence 56 must reach 80) so repairs
     target the measured gap instead of only the findings prose.
